company.name: Big Bear Play
company.shortDescription: Big Bear Play is an online platform that enables MENA region audience to watch originals & all their favorite content on all smart devices
company.description:
Big Bear Play is an upcoming VOD platform company in its early stage headed to disrupting the entertainment market in the MENA region and how people view quality content. The team have gathered more than 200+ scenarios both Egyptian and region wide productions starring numerous stars and talents. Using world class machine learning & Ai that are able to make data driven choices not only by giving recommendations to viewers, but also by giving casting and scenario choices that could be carried on in every original production from movies, series, shows and more to choosing what digital rights to acquire in our library.

Backed by 6 production studios out of 30 of the largest in Egypt totaling 17,000 m2, a highly skilled production & operational team, an exceptional user experience & low tech costs to drive revenue margins in multiple ways including subscriptions & advertisements.
